4663.scope: Use RHScan for all Robinhood Chain explorer navigation, including historical objects. Navigation links are not verification; API routes are not inferred from these UI templates.

record_notes.publisher_verification_claim: An attributed publisher label, not independent live-chain verification by this package. Preserve live_chain_verification_status and lifecycle limits.
record_notes.publisher_linked_provenance_urls: Original publisher hyperlinks retained as source evidence, not default explorer destinations. Return RHScan links for any referenced Robinhood address or transaction using its exact identity; do not transplant provider-specific API paths or query tabs.
record_notes.price_feed_metadata: Publisher-directory provenance is in the parent contract provenance array and covers only the proxy and metadata fields named by its locator, including adjacent feed decimals. It does not establish a token pairing, current round, deployed behavior or NetNet use. Consumer policies and semantics sources remain separately attributed.
record_notes.netnet_use_evidence: Directory inclusion alone does not establish NetNet use. Preserve recorded registry/local provenance and status; an empty consumer_policies list means not recorded, not unused. No exhaustive consumer list or exact-token relationship is inferred.
record_notes.public_role_addresses: Published role attribution only, not proof of control, beneficial ownership, account kind or authority. No private key or personal portfolio information is included.

known_discrepancies.detail: Official Channels still lists 0x99B6eE6eDe47d9a8a9bfd03F728a99B789df1961 as RwaDesk. The public app registry and local definitions identify it as V1 superseded by V2 0xa84efC3136BF1Bb89ade9E5BE6Ab32cb1A04f08D on 2026-08-27. Both addresses are retained; current status is publisher/local-reported, not live verified.

Official Channels says deployed 2026-08-19; app registry dates the listed v1.1 desk to 2026-08-18 at block 40019315 and explicitly supersedes v1.0. No date reconciliation or receipt verification was performed. Long-Dated TurboDesk is distinct from Loopback TurboRouter.

Credit docs say vault mainnet since 2026-09-09 and first loan 2026-09-10 but explicitly keep CreditRouter pending the allocator grant. The app registry identifies the same router address as V2 and identifies a never-granted V1 predecessor. Do not equate vault operation or a public registry address with router activation.

NetNetGear shared loot collection 0x621342F15f86fd5620c5141D0cc1A6ceFDaE28eE and boardroomLoot library 0x6C2B1e062DA09d18389cC563D75B1e1899F2a02f are separate named contracts, not address aliases. Retired initial NetNetGear deployment is also retained.
